editorial:
Imagine landing in beautiful Hawaii, but instead of a relaxing vacation, you are hunting down dangerous criminals for money. That is exactly what you get with Ryan Swan, a tough bounty hunter who is not just working for a paycheck. He is on a mission to find the crime boss who killed his father years ago. The movie feels like a classic revenge story mixed with a lot of fighting and gunplay. You will feel the heat of the islands and the tension as Ryan gets closer to the people who ruined his family. It is a wild ride that does not waste much time getting to the action.

What really works here is how the fights are handled and the fast pace that keeps you from getting bored. While the plot is pretty simple, the energy is high enough to keep you glued to your screen. Some of the dialogue is a bit cheesy, but that just adds to the fun of a popcorn flick. It is a great pick if you just want to turn your brain off and watch someone kick a lot of bad guys.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Ryan finally tracks down the kingpin responsible for his father's death. After a brutal fight and a lot of gunfire, Ryan manages to take down the villain once and for all. He gets the closure he has been seeking for years, cleaning up the crime world in the process. The movie wraps up with Ryan finally finding some peace, knowing that his father's killer is gone and justice has been served.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school revenge movies and fight scenes.
